_doc: PSI's Authentik group → Plunk access (the SEB default, apps/plunk-sso/mapping.json, names the first estate's service account). Authentik group → Plunk access. THE source of truth for who may use Plunk and with which role, re-synced on every sign-in (lib/access.mjs). `managed` = every project in projects.json except the robots'. Roles are Plunk's own: ADMIN (domains, settings, members' view) or MEMBER (templates, campaigns, contacts). OWNER is never mappable: it is the service account's, which owns every project so no person can delete one. A person in several groups gets the HIGHEST role per project. Every group named here must also be bound at the Plunk gate (gitops/platform/authentik/blueprints-providers.yaml, application `plunk`) — a mapped group the gate refuses is a role nobody can use; doctor.sh compares the two lists.
